correctness.rationale: Normal-form lemma classifies all Lie automorphisms as (Av, det(A)t+ell(v)). Necessary two-local conditions follow from scalar pairs, coincident-quotient pairs and independent quotient pairs. Sufficiency constructs an ordinary automorphism for all four pair types; for dependent noncentral quotient vectors, fiber injectivity guarantees the residual ratio is nonzero exactly when required, allowing a prescribed determinant. Unique counting of projective permutations, nonzero representative lifts, fiber bijections and central multiplier gives \((q-1)^{q+2}(q+1)!(q!)^{q+1}\). The checker exhaustively independently tests all bijections over F_2 via ordinary-automorphism pair orbits, and tests seeded examples in F_3 and F_4 including every ordered-pair condition. The arbitrary-field generalization is by proof, not sampling.

value.rationale: Two-local versus global automorphism rigidity is a motivated question originating in the 2016 nilpotent-existence theorem. A complete all-field structural classification identifies independent projective and central-fiber sources of nonlinear freedom, and the exact all-finite-field census quantifies it; the index equals \((q-1)^q(q!)^{q+2}/q^3\), already 2 over \(\mathbb F_2\) and 2304 over \(\mathbb F_3\). This is an intrinsic, naturally defined full class of local symmetries, not an arbitrary sliced invariant or an isolated small-field count.
